verdict.rationale: Granola's own docs state it uses your computer audio and so doesn't invite a bot, and that it works across Zoom, Meet, Teams and other apps, which covers the core no-bot capture. However, its transparency docs say Granola posts a message in the meeting chat when it starts transcribing, which conflicts with 'external participants see nothing extra', and the evidence doesn't say whether that message can be turned off. Missing for 10: documentation that the in-meeting chat notice is optional or can be disabled, and independent hands-on confirmation that participants see nothing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra
